function.name: linux_machine
function.description: Owner-only persistent InstaBox Linux computer (Firecracker VM with /data disk, Debian, desktop+browser on agent-browser). Reused across turns and bot restarts. Use this instead of sandbox when the owner needs work that should last (projects, servers, desktop, files on /data). sandbox/E2B stays for public users and one-shot throwaway runs. Auto-creates or resumes the owner's machine. Home is /data/home.

action.description: Sub-tool to run. create: start a new machine. connect: attach by machineId. info: details. list: list owner machines. kill: delete it. pause: suspend keeping memory. resume: wake it. stop: shut down keeping /data. set_auto_suspend: idle pause ms (0 off on paid plans). run_code: execute python/javascript/typescript/bash. run_command: shell. list_processes / kill_process. files_list, files_read, files_write, files_mkdir, files_remove, files_exists: filesystem under /data/home. download: send a file on WhatsApp. get_url: publish a port as public https. unpublish_port / list_ports. install: pip or npm. desktop_start, desktop_status, desktop_screenshot, desktop_open, desktop_click, desktop_type, desktop_press, desktop_scroll, desktop_move, desktop_stream, desktop_revoke. snapshot. metrics.

machineId.description: Existing InstaBox machine id (m_...). Used by connect, kill, or to reuse a known machine.

template.description: Template when creating: agent-browser (desktop+Chromium, default), universal, ci. Free plan allows agent-browser or ci.

name.description: Optional machine name. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

autoSuspendMs.description: Idle pause in milliseconds. Paid plans: 5-30 minutes or 0 to disable. Free plan is fixed at 30 minutes.

language.description: Language for run_code: python, javascript, typescript, bash. Default python.

background.description: If true, start run_command detached and return the pid.

timeoutMs.description: Command timeout in milliseconds. Default 120000, max 600000.

path.description: Absolute path for filesystem actions. Default /data/home.

files.description: Multiple files for files_write. Each item has path and content.

port.description: Machine port to publish with get_url, for example 3000.

portName.description: Display name when publishing a port.

manager.description: Package manager for install: pip or npm. Default pip.

x.description: X pixel for desktop_click or desktop_move.

y.description: Y pixel for desktop_click or desktop_move.

button.description: Mouse button for desktop_click: left, right, middle.

keys.description: Key or chord for desktop_press, for example Enter or ctrl+l.

direction.description: Scroll direction: up, down, left, right.

viewOnly.description: desktop_stream view-only (default true). false allows control.
